scenario: Qualified namespace per LIMP.9.8 / LIMP.4.1.1 — const importing in expression position. `import ha` lets the importing file reference `ha`'s exported const as `ha.RETRY` in any expression position; the validator inlines its literal value at the use site, mirroring the bare-form behavior pinned by LIMP.9.8a. Pin: `import ha` followed by `let retry_after = ha.RETRY` resolves and inlines the const value (30_s → 30000000000 ns).
rules_ds:
import ha

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    let retry_after = ha.RETRY
    log info "x"
